title: Multi-component transaction consistency
description: Defective starter; make the behavior in task.md true without changing the tests. python3 stdlib; sqlite3 in memory + fake payment gateway.

starter.provenance: Authored for SDKit F05-A (2026-10). No third-party code. The defects are deliberate: see task.md for the required behavior.

requirements.text: Success: stock is decremented, one `orders` row (status `paid`) plus one `order_lines` row per distinct SKU are stored, the customer is charged
Validation: `lines` must be a non-empty list of `(sku, qty, price_cents)` with positive integer `qty` and non-negative integer price,
An unknown SKU, or insufficient stock on ANY line, raises `OrderRejected`. Nothing changes: no stock moves for the other lines, no order rows,
If `charge` raises (`PaymentError`), the exception propagates, all stock changes are undone, and no order rows exist.
If anything fails after a successful charge (for example the database write), the charge is refunded exactly once, stock is restored,
Idempotency: calling again with the same `idem_key` and the same lines returns the original order (equal dict) without charging again and
After any outcome, `sum(charges) - sum(refunds)` equals the total of the stored orders, and stock equals initial stock minus ordered quantities.
